<?php

namespace PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\NumberFormat;

use DateTime;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\Calculation;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\MathTrig;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Reader\Xls\Color\BIFF8;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\Date;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\Color;

abstract class BaseFormatter
{
    /**
     * Matches any @ symbol that isn't enclosed in quotes.
     */
    private const SYMBOL_AT = '/@(?=(?:[^"]*"[^"]*")*[^"]*\Z)/miu';

    /**
     * Matches any ; symbol that isn't enclosed in quotes, for a "section" split.
     */
    private const SECTION_SPLIT = '/;(?=(?:[^"]*"[^"]*")*[^"]*\Z)/miu';

    private const NUMBER_REGEX = '/(0+)(\\.?)(0*)/';

    /**
     * Search/replace values to convert Excel date/time format masks to PHP format masks.
     */
    private const DATE_FORMAT_REPLACEMENTS = [
        '\\' => '',
        'am/pm' => 'A',
        'e' => 'Y',
        'yyyy' => 'Y',
        'yy' => 'y',
        'mmmmm' => 'M',
        'mmmm' => 'F',
        'mmm' => 'M',
        ':mm' => ':i',
        'mm:' => 'i:',
        'dddd' => 'l',
        'ddd' => 'D',
        'dd' => 'd',
        'd' => 'j',
        '.s' => '',
    ];

    private const DATE_FORMAT_REPLACEMENTS24 = [
        'hh' => 'H',
        'h' => 'G',
        'mm' => 'm',
        'm' => 'n',
        'ss' => 's',
    ];

    private const DATE_FORMAT_REPLACEMENTS12 = [
        'hh' => 'h',
        'h' => 'g',
        'mm' => 'm',
        'm' => 'n',
        'ss' => 's',
    ];

    private const HOURS_IN_DAY = 24;
    private const MINUTES_IN_DAY = 60 * self::HOURS_IN_DAY;
    private const SECONDS_IN_DAY = 60 * self::MINUTES_IN_DAY;
    private const INTERVAL_PRECISION = 10;
    private const INTERVAL_LEADING_ZERO = [
        '[hh]',
        '[mm]',
        '[ss]',
    ];
    private const INTERVAL_ROUND_PRECISION = [
        '[h]' => self::INTERVAL_PRECISION,
        '[hh]' => self::INTERVAL_PRECISION,
        '[m]' => self::INTERVAL_PRECISION,
        '[mm]' => self::INTERVAL_PRECISION,
        '[s]' => 0,
        '[ss]' => 0,
    ];
    private const INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER = [
        '[h]' => self::HOURS_IN_DAY,
        '[hh]' => self::HOURS_IN_DAY,
        '[m]' => self::MINUTES_IN_DAY,
        '[mm]' => self::MINUTES_IN_DAY,
        '[s]' => self::SECONDS_IN_DAY,
        '[ss]' => self::SECONDS_IN_DAY,
    ];

    private mixed $workingValue = null;

    private string $workingFormat = '';

    private string $baseMask = '';

    private string $renderedOutput = '';

    private string $sectionColor = '';

    /** @var string[] */
    private array $formatSections = [];

    private bool $thousandsEnabled = false;

    private int $valueScale = 1;

    private bool $paddingEnabled = false;

    private ?array $writerCallback = null;

    private string $activeThousandsSeparator = ',';

    private string $activeDecimalSeparator = '.';

    private string $activeCurrencyCode = '$';

    /** @var string[] */
    private array $sectionColors = ['', '', '', '', ''];

    /** @var string[] */
    private array $sectionOperators = ['', '', '', '', ''];

    /** @var array<int, float|int|string> */
    private array $sectionComparisons = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];

    private mixed $absoluteNumericValue = null;

    /** @var array<int, string> */
    private array $digitMatches = [];

    protected static function stripQuotes(string $format): string
    {
        // Some non-number strings are quoted, so we'll get rid of the quotes, likewise any positional * symbols
        return str_replace(['"', '*'], '', $format);
    }

    protected static function adjustSeparators(string $value): string
    {
        $thousandsSeparator = StringHelper::getThousandsSeparator();
        $decimalSeparator = StringHelper::getDecimalSeparator();
        if ($thousandsSeparator !== ',' || $decimalSeparator !== '.') {
            $value = str_replace(['.', ',', "\u{fffd}"], ["\u{fffd}", '.', ','], $value);
        }

        return $value;
    }

    private function startFormatSession(mixed $value, string $format, ?array $callBack): void
    {
        $this->workingValue = $value;
        $this->workingFormat = $format;
        $this->baseMask = $format;
        $this->renderedOutput = '';
        $this->sectionColor = '';
        $this->formatSections = [];
        $this->thousandsEnabled = false;
        $this->valueScale = 1;
        $this->paddingEnabled = false;
        $this->writerCallback = $callBack;
        $this->absoluteNumericValue = $value;
        $this->digitMatches = [];
        $this->sectionColors = ['', '', '', '', ''];
        $this->sectionOperators = ['', '', '', '', ''];
        $this->sectionComparisons = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
    }

    private function captureLocaleSettings(): void
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === 'General') {
            $this->activeThousandsSeparator = StringHelper::getThousandsSeparator();
            $this->activeDecimalSeparator = StringHelper::getDecimalSeparator();

            return;
        }

        $this->activeThousandsSeparator = StringHelper::getThousandsSeparator();
        $this->activeDecimalSeparator = StringHelper::getDecimalSeparator();
    }

    private function captureCurrencySetting(): void
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === '') {
            $this->activeCurrencyCode = StringHelper::getCurrencyCode();

            return;
        }

        $this->activeCurrencyCode = StringHelper::getCurrencyCode();
    }

    private function rememberBaseMask(): void
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat !== '') {
            $this->baseMask = $this->workingFormat;
        }
    }

    private function handleBooleanValue(): ?string
    {
        if (!is_bool($this->workingValue)) {
            return null;
        }

        if ($this->workingValue) {
            return Calculation::getTRUE();
        }

        return Calculation::getFALSE();
    }

    private function handleAtTextSubstitution(): ?string
    {
        if (preg_match(self::SECTION_SPLIT, $this->workingFormat) !== 0) {
            return null;
        }
        if (preg_match(self::SYMBOL_AT, $this->workingFormat) !== 1) {
            return null;
        }

        return str_replace('"', '', preg_replace(self::SYMBOL_AT, (string) $this->workingValue, $this->workingFormat) ?? '');
    }

    private function handleNonNumericValue(): ?string
    {
        if (is_numeric($this->workingValue)) {
            return null;
        }

        return (string) $this->workingValue;
    }

    private function handleGeneralOrTextMask(): ?string
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === 'General') {
            return self::adjustSeparators((string) $this->workingValue);
        }
        if ($this->workingFormat === '@') {
            return self::adjustSeparators((string) $this->workingValue);
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function stripLocalePrefix(): void
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === '') {
            return;
        }

        $this->workingFormat = (string) preg_replace('/^\[\$-[^\]]*\]/', '', $this->workingFormat);
    }

    private function hideQuotedDots(): void
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === '') {
            return;
        }

        $this->workingFormat = (string) preg_replace_callback(
            '/(["])(?:(?=(\\\\?))\\2.)*?\\1/u',
            fn (array $matches): string => str_replace('.', chr(0x00), $matches[0]),
            $this->workingFormat
        );
    }

    private function quoteEscapedCharacters(): void
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === '') {
            return;
        }

        $this->workingFormat = (string) preg_replace(
            '/(\\\(((.)(?!((AM\/PM)|(A\/P))))|([^ ])))(?=(?:[^"]|"[^"]*")*$)/ui',
            '"${2}"',
            $this->workingFormat
        );
    }

    private function splitFormatSections(): void
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === '') {
            $this->formatSections = [];

            return;
        }

        $this->formatSections = preg_split(self::SECTION_SPLIT, $this->workingFormat) ?: [];
    }

    private function collectSectionMetadata(): void
    {
        $sectionCount = count($this->formatSections);
        $colorRegex = '/\\[(' . implode('|', Color::NAMED_COLORS) . '|color\\s*(\\d+))\\]/mui';
        $condRegex = '/\\[(>|>=|<|<=|=|<>)([+-]?\\d+([.]\\d+)?)\\]/';
        for ($idx = 0; $idx < $sectionCount; ++$idx) {
            if (preg_match($colorRegex, $this->formatSections[$idx], $matches)) {
                if (isset($matches[2])) {
                    $this->sectionColors[$idx] = '#' . BIFF8::lookup((int) $matches[2] + 7)['rgb'];
                } else {
                    $this->sectionColors[$idx] = $matches[0];
                }
                $this->formatSections[$idx] = (string) preg_replace($colorRegex, '', $this->formatSections[$idx]);
            }
            if (preg_match($condRegex, $this->formatSections[$idx], $matches)) {
                $this->sectionOperators[$idx] = $matches[1];
                $this->sectionComparisons[$idx] = $matches[2];
                $this->formatSections[$idx] = (string) preg_replace($condRegex, '', $this->formatSections[$idx]);
            }
        }
    }

    private function compareSectionValue(?string $condition, mixed $comparisonValue, string $defaultCondition, mixed $defaultComparisonValue): bool
    {
        if (!$condition) {
            $condition = $defaultCondition;
            $comparisonValue = $defaultComparisonValue;
        }

        return match ($condition) {
            '>' => $this->workingValue > $comparisonValue,
            '<' => $this->workingValue < $comparisonValue,
            '<=' => $this->workingValue <= $comparisonValue,
            '<>' => $this->workingValue != $comparisonValue,
            '=' => $this->workingValue == $comparisonValue,
            default => $this->workingValue >= $comparisonValue,
        };
    }

    private function selectFormatSection(): void
    {
        $sectionCount = count($this->formatSections);
        $this->sectionColor = $this->sectionColors[0] ?? '';
        $this->workingFormat = $this->formatSections[0] ?? $this->workingFormat;
        $this->absoluteNumericValue = $this->workingValue;

        if ($sectionCount === 2) {
            $this->absoluteNumericValue = abs($this->workingValue);
            if (!$this->compareSectionValue($this->sectionOperators[0], $this->sectionComparisons[0], '>=', 0)) {
                $this->sectionColor = $this->sectionColors[1];
                $this->workingFormat = $this->formatSections[1];
            }

            return;
        }

        if ($sectionCount === 3 || $sectionCount === 4) {
            $this->absoluteNumericValue = abs($this->workingValue);
            if (!$this->compareSectionValue($this->sectionOperators[0], $this->sectionComparisons[0], '>', 0)) {
                if ($this->compareSectionValue($this->sectionOperators[1], $this->sectionComparisons[1], '<', 0)) {
                    $this->sectionColor = $this->sectionColors[1];
                    $this->workingFormat = $this->formatSections[1];
                } else {
                    $this->sectionColor = $this->sectionColors[2];
                    $this->workingFormat = $this->formatSections[2];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private function applyUnderscoreSpacing(): void
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === '') {
            return;
        }

        $this->workingFormat = (string) preg_replace('/_.?/ui', ' ', $this->workingFormat);
    }

    private function isDateTimeMask(): bool
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === '') {
            return false;
        }
        if (preg_match('/(\[\$[A-Z]*-[0-9A-F]*\])*[hmsdy](?=(?:[^"]|"[^"]*")*$)/miu', $this->workingFormat) !== 1) {
            return false;
        }
        if (preg_match('/[0\?#]\.(?![^\[]*\])/miu', $this->workingFormat) !== 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function isPercentageMask(): bool
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === '') {
            return false;
        }

        return (bool) preg_match('/[0#, ]%/', $this->workingFormat);
    }

    private function isQuotedLiteralMask(): bool
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === '') {
            return false;
        }
        if (!str_starts_with($this->workingFormat, '"')) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!str_ends_with($this->workingFormat, '"')) {
            return false;
        }

        return substr_count($this->workingFormat, '"') === 2;
    }

    private function isFractionMask(): bool
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === '') {
            return false;
        }

        return (bool) preg_match('/[#\?0]?.*[#\?0]\/(\?+|\d+|#)/', $this->workingFormat);
    }

    private function classifyCurrentMask(): string
    {
        if ($this->isDateTimeMask()) {
            return 'datetime';
        }
        if ($this->isQuotedLiteralMask()) {
            return 'literal';
        }
        if ($this->isPercentageMask()) {
            return 'percentage';
        }

        return 'number';
    }

    private function dispatchCurrentMask(): void
    {
        $kind = $this->classifyCurrentMask();
        if ($kind === 'datetime') {
            $this->workingValue = DateFormatter::format($this->workingValue, $this->workingFormat);
            $this->renderedOutput = (string) $this->workingValue;

            return;
        }
        if ($kind === 'literal') {
            $this->executeLiteralMask();

            return;
        }
        if ($kind === 'percentage') {
            $this->workingValue = PercentageFormatter::format(0 + (float) $this->workingValue, $this->workingFormat);
            $this->renderedOutput = (string) $this->workingValue;

            return;
        }

        $this->workingValue = NumberFormatter::format($this->workingValue, $this->workingFormat);
        $this->renderedOutput = (string) $this->workingValue;
    }

    private function executeLiteralMask(): void
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === '') {
            $this->renderedOutput = '';

            return;
        }

        $this->renderedOutput = substr($this->workingFormat, 1, -1);
        $this->workingValue = $this->renderedOutput;
    }

    private function applyWriterCallback(): void
    {
        if ($this->writerCallback === null) {
            return;
        }

        [$writerInstance, $function] = $this->writerCallback;
        $this->renderedOutput = $writerInstance->$function($this->renderedOutput !== '' ? $this->renderedOutput : $this->workingValue, $this->sectionColor);
        $this->workingValue = $this->renderedOutput;
    }

    private function restoreHiddenDots(): void
    {
        $output = $this->renderedOutput !== '' ? $this->renderedOutput : (string) $this->workingValue;
        $this->renderedOutput = str_replace(chr(0x00), '.', $output);
        $this->workingValue = $this->renderedOutput;
    }

    public function renderFormattedValue(mixed $value, string $format, ?array $callBack = null): string
    {
        $this->startFormatSession($value, $format, $callBack);
        $this->captureLocaleSettings();
        $this->captureCurrencySetting();
        $this->rememberBaseMask();

        $booleanResult = $this->handleBooleanValue();
        if ($booleanResult !== null) {
            return $booleanResult;
        }

        $atResult = $this->handleAtTextSubstitution();
        if ($atResult !== null) {
            return $atResult;
        }

        $textResult = $this->handleNonNumericValue();
        if ($textResult !== null) {
            return $textResult;
        }

        $generalResult = $this->handleGeneralOrTextMask();
        if ($generalResult !== null) {
            return $generalResult;
        }

        $this->stripLocalePrefix();
        $this->hideQuotedDots();
        $this->quoteEscapedCharacters();
        $this->splitFormatSections();
        $this->collectSectionMetadata();
        $this->selectFormatSection();
        $this->applyUnderscoreSpacing();
        $this->workingValue = $this->absoluteNumericValue;
        $this->dispatchCurrentMask();
        $this->applyWriterCallback();
        $this->restoreHiddenDots();

        return $this->renderedOutput;
    }

    private function applyNumericScale(): void
    {
        if ($this->valueScale === 1) {
            return;
        }
        if (!is_numeric($this->workingValue)) {
            return;
        }

        $this->workingValue = $this->workingValue / $this->valueScale;
    }

    private function convertHashPlaceholders(): void
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === '') {
            return;
        }

        $this->workingFormat = self::replaceFirstPattern('/[\\#\?](?=(?:[^"]*"[^"]*")*[^"]*\Z)/', '0', $this->workingFormat);

    }

    private function executePercentageMask(): void
    {
        $value = $this->workingValue;
        $format = $this->workingFormat;
        if ($format === '0%') {
            $this->renderedOutput = round((100 * $value), 0) . '%';
            $this->workingValue = $this->renderedOutput;

            return;
        }

        $value *= 100;
        $format = self::stripQuotes($format);

        [, $vDecimals] = explode('.', ((string) $value) . '.');
        $vDecimalCount = strlen(rtrim($vDecimals, '0'));

        $format = str_replace('%', '%%', $format);
        $wholePartSize = strlen((string) floor($value));
        $decimalPartSize = 0;
        $placeHolders = '';
        if (preg_match('/\.([?0]+)/u', $format, $matches)) {
            $decimalPartSize = strlen($matches[1]);
            $vMinDecimalCount = strlen(rtrim($matches[1], '?'));
            $decimalPartSize = min(max($vMinDecimalCount, $vDecimalCount), $decimalPartSize);
            $placeHolders = str_repeat(' ', strlen($matches[1]) - $decimalPartSize);
        }
        if (preg_match('/([#0,]+)\.?/u', $format, $matches)) {
            $firstZero = preg_replace('/^[#,]*/', '', $matches[1]) ?? '';
            $wholePartSize = max($wholePartSize, strlen($firstZero));
        }

        $wholePartSize += $decimalPartSize + (int) ($decimalPartSize > 0);
        $replacement = "0{$wholePartSize}.{$decimalPartSize}";
        $mask = (string) preg_replace('/[#0,]+\.?[?#0,]*/ui', "%{$replacement}F{$placeHolders}", $format);

        /** @var float $valueFloat */
        $valueFloat = $value;
        $this->workingValue = $valueFloat;
        $this->workingFormat = $format;
        $this->renderedOutput = self::adjustSeparators(sprintf($mask, round($valueFloat, $decimalPartSize)));
        $this->workingValue = $this->renderedOutput;
    }

    private function executeFractionMask(): void
    {
        $format = self::stripQuotes($this->workingFormat);
        $value = (float) $this->workingValue;
        $absValue = abs($value);
        $sign = ($value < 0.0) ? '-' : '';
        $integerPart = floor($absValue);
        $decimalPart = self::extractDecimalDigits((string) $absValue);
        if ($decimalPart === '0') {
            $this->renderedOutput = "{$sign}{$integerPart}";
            $this->workingValue = $this->renderedOutput;

            return;
        }
        $decimalLength = strlen($decimalPart);
        $decimalDivisor = 10 ** $decimalLength;

        preg_match('/(#?.*\?)\/(\?+|\d+)/', $format, $matches);
        $formatIntegerPart = $matches[1];

        if (is_numeric($matches[2])) {
            $fractionDivisor = 100 / (int) $matches[2];
        } else {
            /** @var float $fractionDivisor */
            $fractionDivisor = MathTrig\Gcd::evaluate((int) $decimalPart, $decimalDivisor);
        }

        $adjustedDecimalPart = (int) round((int) $decimalPart / $fractionDivisor, 0);
        $adjustedDecimalDivisor = $decimalDivisor / $fractionDivisor;
        $this->workingFormat = $format;

        if ((str_contains($formatIntegerPart, '0'))) {
            $this->renderedOutput = "{$sign}{$integerPart} {$adjustedDecimalPart}/{$adjustedDecimalDivisor}";
        } elseif ((str_contains($formatIntegerPart, '#'))) {
            if ($integerPart == 0) {
                $this->renderedOutput = "{$sign}{$adjustedDecimalPart}/{$adjustedDecimalDivisor}";
            } else {
                $this->renderedOutput = "{$sign}{$integerPart} {$adjustedDecimalPart}/{$adjustedDecimalDivisor}";
            }
        } elseif ((str_starts_with($formatIntegerPart, '? ?'))) {
            if ($integerPart == 0) {
                $integerPart = '';
            }
            $this->renderedOutput = "{$sign}{$integerPart} {$adjustedDecimalPart}/{$adjustedDecimalDivisor}";
        } else {
            $adjustedDecimalPart += $integerPart * $adjustedDecimalDivisor;
            $this->renderedOutput = "{$sign}{$adjustedDecimalPart}/{$adjustedDecimalDivisor}";
        }

        $this->workingValue = $this->renderedOutput;
    }

    private function executeDateMask(): void
    {
        $format = (string) preg_replace('/^(\[DBNum\d\])*(\[\$[^\]]*\])/i', '', $this->workingFormat);
        $callable = [self::class, 'setLowercaseCallback'];
        $format = (string) preg_replace_callback('/(?:^|")([^"]*)(?:$|")/', $callable, $format);

        $blocks = explode('"', $format);
        foreach ($blocks as $key => &$block) {
            if ($key % 2 == 0) {
                $block = $this->applyExcelDateReplacements($block);
                if (!strpos($block, 'A')) {
                    $seekingBracket = true;
                    $this->tryDateInterval($seekingBracket, $block, '[h]');
                    $this->tryDateInterval($seekingBracket, $block, '[hh]');
                    $this->tryDateInterval($seekingBracket, $block, '[mm]');
                    $this->tryDateInterval($seekingBracket, $block, '[m]');
                    $this->tryDateInterval($seekingBracket, $block, '[s]');
                    $this->tryDateInterval($seekingBracket, $block, '[ss]');
                    $block = $this->applyTwentyFourHourReplacements($block);
                } else {
                    $block = $this->applyTwelveHourReplacements($block);
                }
            }
        }
        $format = implode('"', $blocks);

        $callback = [self::class, 'escapeQuotesCallback'];
        $format = (string) preg_replace_callback('/"(.*)"/U', $callback, $format);
        $dateObj = Date::excelToDateTimeObject($this->workingValue);
        $format = (string) \preg_replace('/\\\\:m/', ':i', $format);
        $this->workingFormat = $format;
        $this->renderedOutput = $this->renderDateTimeObject($dateObj, $format);
        $this->workingValue = $this->renderedOutput;
    }

    private function applyExcelDateReplacements(string $block): string
    {
        if ($this->workingFormat === '') {
            return strtr($block, self::DATE_FORMAT_REPLACEMENTS);
        }

        return strtr($block, self::DATE_FORMAT_REPLACEMENTS);
    }

    private function applyTwentyFourHourReplacements(string $block): string
    {
        if ($this->workingValue === null) {
            return strtr($block, self::DATE_FORMAT_REPLACEMENTS24);
        }

        return strtr($block, self::DATE_FORMAT_REPLACEMENTS24);
    }

    private function applyTwelveHourReplacements(string $block): string
    {
        if ($this->workingValue === null) {
            return strtr($block, self::DATE_FORMAT_REPLACEMENTS12);
        }

        return strtr($block, self::DATE_FORMAT_REPLACEMENTS12);
    }

    private function tryDateInterval(bool &$seekingBracket, string &$block, string $format): void
    {
        if (!$seekingBracket) {
            return;
        }
        if (!str_contains($block, $format)) {
            return;
        }
        if ($this->workingValue === null) {
            return;
        }

        $hours = (string) (int) round(
            self::INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER[$format] * $this->workingValue,
            self::INTERVAL_ROUND_PRECISION[$format]
        );
        if (strlen($hours) === 1 && in_array($format, self::INTERVAL_LEADING_ZERO, true)) {
            $hours = "0$hours";
        }
        $block = str_replace($format, $hours, $block);
        $seekingBracket = false;
    }

    private function renderDateTimeObject(DateTime $dateObj, string $format): string
    {
        $microseconds = (int) $dateObj->format('u');
        if (str_contains($format, ':s.000')) {
            return $this->renderMillisecondDate($dateObj, $format, $microseconds);
        }
        if (str_contains($format, ':s.00')) {
            return $this->renderCentisecondDate($dateObj, $format, $microseconds);
        }
        if (str_contains($format, ':s.0')) {
            return $this->renderDecisecondDate($dateObj, $format, $microseconds);
        }

        return $this->renderWholeSecondDate($dateObj, $format, $microseconds);
    }

    private function renderMillisecondDate(DateTime $dateObj, string $format, int $microseconds): string
    {
        $milliseconds = (int) round($microseconds / 1000.0);
        if ($milliseconds === 1000) {
            $milliseconds = 0;
            $dateObj->modify('+1 second');
        }
        $dateObj->modify("-$microseconds microseconds");
        $format = str_replace(':s.000', ':s.' . sprintf('%03d', $milliseconds), $format);
        $this->workingFormat = $format;

        return $dateObj->format($format);
    }

    private function renderCentisecondDate(DateTime $dateObj, string $format, int $microseconds): string
    {
        $centiseconds = (int) round($microseconds / 10000.0);
        if ($centiseconds === 100) {
            $centiseconds = 0;
            $dateObj->modify('+1 second');
        }
        $dateObj->modify("-$microseconds microseconds");
        $format = str_replace(':s.00', ':s.' . sprintf('%02d', $centiseconds), $format);
        $this->workingFormat = $format;

        return $dateObj->format($format);
    }

    private function renderDecisecondDate(DateTime $dateObj, string $format, int $microseconds): string
    {
        $deciseconds = (int) round($microseconds / 100000.0);
        if ($deciseconds === 10) {
            $deciseconds = 0;
            $dateObj->modify('+1 second');
        }
        $dateObj->modify("-$microseconds microseconds");
        $format = str_replace(':s.0', ':s.' . sprintf('%1d', $deciseconds), $format);
        $this->workingFormat = $format;

        return $dateObj->format($format);
    }

    private function renderWholeSecondDate(DateTime $dateObj, string $format, int $microseconds): string
    {
        if ($microseconds >= 500000) {
            $dateObj->modify('+1 second');
        }
        $dateObj->modify("-$microseconds microseconds");
        $this->workingFormat = $format;

        return $dateObj->format($format);
    }

    private static function setLowercaseCallback(array $matches): string
    {
        return mb_strtolower($matches[0]);
    }

    private static function escapeQuotesCallback(array $matches): string
    {
        return '\\' . implode('\\', str_split($matches[1]));
    }

    private static function mergeComplexNumberFormatMasks(array $numbers, array $masks): array
    {
        $decimalCount = strlen($numbers[1]);
        $postDecimalMasks = [];

        do {
            $tempMask = array_pop($masks);
            if ($tempMask !== null) {
                $postDecimalMasks[] = $tempMask;
                $decimalCount -= strlen($tempMask);
            }
        } while ($tempMask !== null && $decimalCount > 0);

        return [
            implode('.', $masks),
            implode('.', array_reverse($postDecimalMasks)),
        ];
    }

    private static function processComplexNumberFormatMask(mixed $number, string $mask): string
    {
        /** @var string $result */
        $result = $number;
        $maskingBlockCount = preg_match_all('/0+/', $mask, $maskingBlocks, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE);

        if ($maskingBlockCount > 1) {
            $maskingBlocks = array_reverse($maskingBlocks[0]);

            $offset = 0;
            foreach ($maskingBlocks as $block) {
                $size = strlen($block[0]);
                $divisor = 10 ** $size;
                $offset = $block[1];

                /** @var float $numberFloat */
                $numberFloat = $number;
                $blockValue = sprintf("%0{$size}d", fmod($numberFloat, $divisor));
                $number = floor($numberFloat / $divisor);
                $mask = substr_replace($mask, $blockValue, $offset, $size);
            }
            /** @var string $numberString */
            $numberString = $number;
            if ($number > 0) {
                $mask = substr_replace($mask, $numberString, $offset, 0);
            }
            $result = $mask;
        }

        return self::makePlainString($result);
    }

    private static function complexNumberFormatMask(mixed $number, string $mask, bool $splitOnPoint = true): string
    {
        /** @var float $numberFloat */
        $numberFloat = $number;
        if ($splitOnPoint) {
            $masks = explode('.', $mask);
            if (count($masks) <= 2) {
                $decmask = $masks[1] ?? '';
                $decpos = substr_count($decmask, '0');
                $numberFloat = round($numberFloat, $decpos);
            }
        }
        $sign = ($numberFloat < 0.0) ? '-' : '';
        $number = self::convertFloatToPlainString(abs($numberFloat));

        if ($splitOnPoint && str_contains($mask, '.') && str_contains($number, '.')) {
            $numbers = explode('.', $number);
            $masks = explode('.', $mask);
            if (count($masks) > 2) {
                $masks = self::mergeComplexNumberFormatMasks($numbers, $masks);
            }
            $integerPart = self::complexNumberFormatMask($numbers[0], $masks[0], false);
            $numlen = strlen($numbers[1]);
            $msklen = strlen($masks[1]);
            if ($numlen < $msklen) {
                $numbers[1] .= str_repeat('0', $msklen - $numlen);
            }
            $decimalPart = strrev(self::complexNumberFormatMask(strrev($numbers[1]), strrev($masks[1]), false));
            $decimalPart = substr($decimalPart, 0, $msklen);

            return "{$sign}{$integerPart}.{$decimalPart}";
        }

        if (strlen($number) < strlen($mask)) {
            $number = str_repeat('0', strlen($mask) - strlen($number)) . $number;
        }
        $result = self::processComplexNumberFormatMask($number, $mask);

        return "{$sign}{$result}";
    }

    public static function convertFloatToPlainString(float $f): string
    {
        return self::convertScientificString((string) $f);
    }

    public static function convertScientificString(string $s): string
    {
        if (preg_match('/^([+-])?([1-9])([.]([0-9]+))?[eE]([+-]?[0-9]+)$/', $s, $matches) === 1) {
            $exponent = (int) $matches[5];
            $sign = ($matches[1] === '-') ? '-' : '';
            if ($exponent >= 0) {
                $exponentPlus1 = $exponent + 1;
                $out = $matches[2] . $matches[4];
                $len = strlen($out);
                if ($len < $exponentPlus1) {
                    $out .= str_repeat('0', $exponentPlus1 - $len);
                }
                $out = substr($out, 0, $exponentPlus1) . ((strlen($out) === $exponentPlus1) ? '' : ('.' . substr($out, $exponentPlus1)));
                $s = "$sign$out";
            } else {
                $s = $sign . '0.' . str_repeat('0', -$exponent - 1) . $matches[2] . $matches[4];
            }
        }

        return $s;
    }

    private function formatStraightNumericValue(mixed $value, string $format, array $matches, bool $useThousands): string
    {
        $this->workingValue = $value;
        $this->workingFormat = $format;

        /** @var float $valueFloat */
        $valueFloat = $value;
        $left = $matches[1];
        $dec = $matches[2];
        $right = $matches[3];

        $minWidth = strlen($left) + strlen($dec) + strlen($right);
        if ($useThousands) {
            $formatted = number_format(
                $valueFloat,
                strlen($right),
                StringHelper::getDecimalSeparator(),
                StringHelper::getThousandsSeparator()
            );

            return self::replaceFirstPattern(self::NUMBER_REGEX, $formatted, $format);
        }

        if (preg_match('/[0#]E[+-]0/i', $format)) {
            $decimals = strlen($right);
            $size = $decimals + 3;

            return sprintf("%{$size}.{$decimals}E", $valueFloat);
        }
        if (preg_match('/0([^\d\.]+)0/', $format) || substr_count($format, '.') > 1) {
            if ($valueFloat == floor($valueFloat) && substr_count($format, '.') === 1) {
                $value *= 10 ** strlen(explode('.', $format)[1]);
            }

            $result = self::complexNumberFormatMask($value, $format);
            if (str_contains($result, 'E')) {
                $result = self::convertFloatToPlainString($valueFloat);
            }

            return $result;
        }

        $sprintf_pattern = "%0$minWidth." . strlen($right) . 'F';
        $formatted = self::adjustSeparators(sprintf($sprintf_pattern, round($valueFloat, strlen($right))));

        return self::replaceFirstPattern(self::NUMBER_REGEX, $formatted, $format);
    }

    private static function makePlainString(array|string $value): string
    {
        return is_array($value) ? '' : "$value";
    }

    private static function replaceFirstPattern(string $pattern, string $replacement, string $subject): string
    {
        return self::makePlainString(preg_replace($pattern, $replacement, $subject) ?? '');
    }

    public static function padFormattedValue(string $value, string $baseFormat): string
    {
        $preDecimal = $postDecimal = '';
        $pregArray = preg_split('/\.(?=(?:[^"]*"[^"]*")*[^"]*\Z)/miu', $baseFormat . '.?');
        if (is_array($pregArray)) {
            $preDecimal = $pregArray[0] ?? '';
            $postDecimal = $pregArray[1] ?? '';
        }

        $length = strlen($value);
        if (str_contains($postDecimal, '?')) {
            $value = str_pad(rtrim($value, '0. '), $length, ' ', STR_PAD_RIGHT);
        }
        if (str_contains($preDecimal, '?')) {
            $value = str_pad(ltrim($value, '0, '), $length, ' ', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        }

        return $value;
    }

    public static function detectThousandsRequirement(string &$format): bool
    {
        $useThousands = (bool) preg_match('/([#\?0]),([#\?0])/', $format);
        if ($useThousands) {
            $format = self::replaceFirstPattern('/([#\?0]),([#\?0])/', '${1}${2}', $format);
        }

        return $useThousands;
    }

    public static function detectThousandsMillionsScale(string &$format): int
    {
        $scale = 1;
        if (preg_match('/(#|0|\?)(,+)/', $format, $matches)) {
            $scale = 1000 ** strlen($matches[2]);
            $format = self::replaceFirstPattern('/([#\?0]),+/', '${1}', $format);
        }

        return $scale;
    }

    private static function extractDecimalDigits(string $value): string
    {
        $decimalPart = '0';
        if (preg_match('/^\\d*[.](\\d*[1-9])0*$/', $value, $matches) === 1) {
            $decimalPart = $matches[1];
        }

        return $decimalPart;
    }

    public static function composeNumberMask(int $decimals, bool $thousandsSeparator): string
    {
        return self::thousandsPrefix($thousandsSeparator) . '0' . self::decimalSuffix($decimals);
    }

    public static function composePercentageMask(int $decimals, ?string $localeFormat): string
    {
        if ($localeFormat !== null) {
            return $localeFormat;
        }

        return '0' . self::decimalSuffix($decimals) . '%';
    }

    public static function composeScientificMask(int $decimals): string
    {
        return '0' . self::decimalSuffix($decimals) . 'E+00';
    }

    public static function composeCurrencyMask(
        string $currencyCode,
        int $decimals,
        bool $thousandsSeparator,
        bool $leadingSymbol,
        bool $withSpacing,
        ?string $locale,
        ?string $localeFormat
    ): string {
        if ($localeFormat !== null) {
            return $localeFormat;
        }

        $symbol = self::localizedCurrencyToken($currencyCode, $locale, false);
        $space = self::currencySpacing($withSpacing);
        $thousands = self::thousandsPrefix($thousandsSeparator);
        $decimal = self::decimalSuffix($decimals);
        if ($leadingSymbol) {
            return sprintf('%s%s%s0%s', $symbol, $space, $thousands, $decimal);
        }

        return sprintf('%s0%s%s%s', $thousands, $decimal, $space, $symbol);
    }

    public static function composeAccountingMask(
        string $currencyCode,
        int $decimals,
        bool $thousandsSeparator,
        bool $leadingSymbol,
        bool $withSpacing,
        ?string $locale,
        ?string $localeFormat
    ): string {
        if ($localeFormat !== null) {
            return $localeFormat;
        }

        $symbol = self::localizedCurrencyToken($currencyCode, $locale, true);
        $space = self::currencySpacing($withSpacing);
        $thousands = self::thousandsPrefix($thousandsSeparator);
        $decimal = self::decimalSuffix($decimals);
        if ($leadingSymbol) {
            return sprintf('_-%s%s%s0%s_-', $symbol, $space, $thousands, $decimal);
        }

        return sprintf('_-%s0%s%s%s_-', $thousands, $decimal, $space, $symbol);
    }

    public static function composeDateMask(array $formatBlocks, array $separators): string
    {
        $mask = '';
        $separatorCount = count($separators);
        foreach ($formatBlocks as $index => $block) {
            $mask .= $block;
            if ($index < $separatorCount) {
                $mask .= $separators[$index];
            }
        }

        return $mask;
    }

    public static function composeTimeMask(array $formatBlocks, array $separators): string
    {
        return self::composeDateMask($formatBlocks, $separators);
    }

    public static function wrapDateLiteral(string $value): string
    {
        if (mb_strlen($value, 'UTF-8') === 1) {
            if (str_contains("$+-/():!^&'~{}<>= ", $value)) {
                return $value;
            }

            return "\\{$value}";
        }

        return '"' . str_replace('"', '""', $value) . '"';
    }

    public static function mapDateFormatBlock(string $value, array $allowedBlocks): string
    {
        if (self::isDateToken($value, $allowedBlocks)) {
            return mb_strtolower($value);
        }

        return self::wrapDateLiteral($value);
    }

    public static function mapTimeFormatBlock(string $value, array $allowedBlocks, string $morningAfternoon = 'AM/PM'): string
    {
        if (self::isTimeToken($value, $allowedBlocks)) {
            return mb_strtolower($value);
        }
        if (mb_strtoupper($value) === $morningAfternoon) {
            return mb_strtoupper($value);
        }

        return self::wrapDateLiteral($value);
    }

    public static function decimalSuffix(int $decimals): string
    {
        if ($decimals <= 0) {
            return '';
        }

        return '.' . str_repeat('0', $decimals);
    }

    public static function thousandsPrefix(bool $thousandsSeparator): string
    {
        if (!$thousandsSeparator) {
            return '';
        }

        return '#,##';
    }

    public static function currencySpacing(bool $withSpacing): string
    {
        if (!$withSpacing) {
            return '';
        }

        return "\u{a0}";
    }

    public static function localizedCurrencyToken(string $currencyCode, ?string $locale, bool $accounting = false): string
    {
        if ($locale !== null) {
            return "[\${$currencyCode}-{$locale}]";
        }
        if ($accounting) {
            return $currencyCode . '*';
        }

        return $currencyCode;
    }

    public static function padSeparatorList(array $separators, int $count): array
    {
        $lastSeparator = array_pop($separators);

        return $separators + array_fill(0, $count, $lastSeparator);
    }

    public static function composeDurationMask(array $formatBlocks, array $separators): string
    {
        return self::composeDateMask($formatBlocks, $separators);
    }

    public static function isDateToken(string $value, array $allowedBlocks): bool
    {
        return in_array(mb_strtolower($value), $allowedBlocks, true);
    }

    public static function isTimeToken(string $value, array $allowedBlocks): bool
    {
        return in_array(mb_strtolower($value), $allowedBlocks, true);
    }

    public static function isDurationToken(string $value, array $allowedBlocks): bool
    {
        return in_array(mb_strtolower($value), $allowedBlocks, true);
    }

    public static function firstDurationMask(string $block, array $durationDefaults): string
    {
        $token = mb_strtolower($block);
        if (array_key_exists($token, $durationDefaults)) {
            return $durationDefaults[$token];
        }

        return $block;
    }

    public static function convertDurationOverflow(string $value, array $durationMasks, bool $durationAlreadySet): string
    {
        $token = mb_strtolower($value);
        if (!$durationAlreadySet) {
            return $token;
        }
        if (array_key_exists($token, $durationMasks)) {
            return $durationMasks[$token];
        }

        return $token;
    }
}

abstract class BaseFormatter
{
    protected static function stripQuotes(string $format): string
    {

    protected static function adjustSeparators(string $value): string
    {

        }
